newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE 139-1 AT LUNCH AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE 139-1 AT LUNCH AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Free State, chasing 472 to win from a minimum of 130 overs, were 139 for one in their second innings at lunch on the final day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Natal at Kingsmead on Monday.
Natal 282 (Dale Benkenstein 100, Neil Johnson 50) and 349 for seven declared (Derek Crookes 52, Jonty Rhodes 156 not out).
Free State 160 (Boeta Dippenaar 81) and 139 for one in 61 overs (Deon Jordaan 75 not out).
